reason: The hypothesis directly restates the exact material system (Pd1@HEFO), mechanism (Pd–O–M bonds, enhanced reducibility), predicted outcome (lower light-off temperature, improved durability), and application (diesel oxidation) already demonstrated in P6 and P28. The only addition is a generic link to configurational disorder from P15, but this does not constitute a new synthesis or transfer to a new regime; it merely repackages the existing result as a prediction.
copied_elements: High-entropy fluorite oxide (HEFO) support for single-atom Pd
Stabilization of Pd single atoms via Pd–O–M bonds
Resistance to thermal and hydrothermal degradation
Increasing configurational disorder improves oxidation performance
